claims.evidence: No video or audio of the machine running is available; photo is static.
Brand 'JUKI' is visible on the arm, but country of manufacture and motor performance cannot be confirmed from a still photo; JUKI machines are made in multiple countries.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual included
claims.evidence: No accessories, bobbins, extra feet, or manual are visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: Maintenance history cannot be assessed from a photo; no service tags or records shown.

risks.risk: Motor and stitching mechanism may not actually function
risks.proof: A short video of the machine running a stitch line under load

risks.risk: Wiring and plug may be unsafe or non-standard for Nigerian sockets
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the plug, cord condition, and wiring to the motor
risks.if_unproven: priced with deduction for rewiring/safety check needed

risks.risk: Accessories (bobbins, needles, feet) and manual may be missing
risks.proof: Photo of all accessories and manual laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare machine only, no accessories

risks.risk: Model and true origin (Japan vs other factory) unknown, affecting value
risks.proof: Clear photo of the model/serial plate, usually on the machine arm or base
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic/unknown-model JUKI, lower tier

risks.risk: Table and stand wear may indicate heavy prior use or instability
risks.proof: Photo of table legs, stand joints, and underside motor mount
risks.if_unproven: priced with deduction for cosmetic/structural wear

proof_requests: Video of the machine stitching fabric to confirm it runs
Photo of all included accessories and the manual
Close-up of the power cord, plug, and motor wiring
Photo of the underside stand and motor mount for structural condition
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a JUKI industrial sewing machine, but all seller claims about function, origin, accessories, and service history are unverifiable from the single static photo, so it must be priced at worst-case working/accessory condition pending proof.
